blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Opao Elementary School in Mandaue City has intensified its preventive measures against dengue following reports of dengue-related deaths involving two kindergarten pupils, one of whom was from Barangay Opao. School principal Queenie Cacanog said the school conducted a general clean-up on Wednesday, November 18, involving teachers and Parent-Teacher Association (PTA) officers to eliminate potential mosquito breeding sites within the campus. The clean-up included disposing of containers that could collect stagnant water and covering water storage containers.
